newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Megaworld sets rights offer at 2.67 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Megaworld sets rights offer at 2.67 pesos.

text.p: Real estate developer Megaworld Properties & Holdings Inc has set the offer price for its one-for-three rights issue at 2.67 pesos per share.
The offer involves the sale of 930 million unissued common shares, a prospectus submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday showed.
Megaworld closed at 3.50 pesos on Wednesday, down 25 centavos from previous day's close.
The company is expected to generate 2.48 billion pesos from the rights offer.
Megaworld intends to use the proceeds to partially finance the construction of MPHI's projects, refinance maturing loans, and working capital.

It would allot 700 million pesos for its residential Parkview building, 560 million for the office building World Commerce Plaza, and 521 million for the residential-commercial urban town Eastwood City.
Another 500 million would be earmarked for maturing loans and 200 million for working capital.
